title: 第15章 我成婚了第16章 他们的筹码
slug: 什么你说修真界大佬全都是我弟
content_zh:
回到孤云峰上。
只有夏以苜和林朔风两人的时候，林朔风终于开始询问岳冉将她带走后，发生了什么。
“姐，你在云雾裂谷中遇到了什么？”
虽说夏以苜已经引气入体，可以她目前的修为，难以应对云雾裂谷中的情况。
连活下来都难，更莫说是完好无损从云雾裂谷中走出来。
夏以苜想到那个有些邪气，又有些厌世的男人，欲言又止。
她该怎么和她的小老弟说，她去了一趟云雾山谷，便和一个男人英年早婚了呢？
但她向来直接，于是用吓死人不偿命的平静语气道：“我成婚了。”
林朔风刚坐下，先给夏以苜倒了一盏茶，随后自己也端起茶盏喝了一口。
可听到他姐的话，嘴里的茶水一口喷出。
他本来是面对着夏以苜的，为了防止茶水喷到他姐脸上，愣是在关键时候转了头。
紧接着便是剧烈咳嗽，咳得林朔风一张脸都涨红成了猪肝色。
“咳咳咳咳咳咳！”
夏以苜起身拍了拍他的背，“不至于这么大反应吧？听说你要和岳冉联姻的时候，我的反应也没有这么大啊。”
林朔风差点给自己呛死，好一会儿才缓过来，“这当然不一样！”
他那是还没成婚，而他姐是已经成婚，还是在她消失的几个时辰里，突然就成婚了。
不管是现代还是修真界，两个世界里能配得上他姐的人都还没有出生！
林朔风显然不能接受这个事实。
“姐，你不是在和我开玩笑吧？这一点都不好笑。”
可看到他姐“你说呢”的表情，林朔风彻底天塌了。

“那个男人是谁？这到底是怎么回事？”
夏以苜将她落下云雾山谷后发生的事情娓娓道来。
林朔风表情越来越难看，他们的婚契甚至还是生死契，若是那个男人出事，连累了他姐该怎么办？
“就是这样，你知道那个妄殊是什么人吗？”
此刻她唯一担心的事情就是，她会不会放出来了一个作恶多端的魔头。
林朔风的眉头已经拧成了一个川字，“没有听说过这个人，我之后去查查。”
“还有你手腕上的，到底是什么东西？”
就是因为这个东西，他姐才会被迫和一个陌生男人成婚。
但若是没有这东西生成的护盾，他姐估计也没命了。
夏以苜晃了晃她右手手腕，“不知道，原主记忆里也没有这东西。”
她分不清这东西对她是好是坏，目前来看，她偏向于好的更多一点。
只是不知道它为何非要让她和妄殊成婚。
她又将妄殊的一些特征描述了一遍，只让林朔风去对着那些魔头找，只要确定对方不是魔头，她便放心了。
林朔风点头，仔细记下。
势必要将那个该死的男人给抓出来。
前面提到原主，夏以苜倒是想到了一件事，“我之后要回东宁村一趟。”
东东宁村便是原主生活的村子。
“原主是来紫云宗送灵植的，灵植送完了，该回村去汇报一下情况，把报酬给他们带回去。”
content_en:
Return to Guyun Peak.
When Xia Yishuo and Lin Shuofeng were alone, Lin Shuofeng finally began to ask what happened after Yue Ran took her away.
"Sister, what did you encounter in the Cloud Rift Valley?"
Although Xia Yilu has introduced Qi into her body, with her current cultivation level, it is difficult for her to cope with the situation in the cloud and mist rift valley.
It was difficult to even survive, let alone come out of the cloud rift intact.
Xia Yihuan hesitated to speak when he thought of the evil-minded and world-weary man.
How should she tell her little brother that she went to the Cloud Valley and got married young to a man?
But she had always been direct, so she said in a calm tone that was scary enough to kill people: "I'm married."
As soon as Lin Shuofeng sat down, he first poured a cup of tea for Xia Yilu, and then took a sip himself.
But after hearing his sister's words, the tea in his mouth spurted out.
He was originally facing Xia Yilu, but in order to prevent the tea from spraying on his sister's face, he turned his head at the critical moment.
Then came a violent cough, which made Lin Shuofeng's face turn red to the color of pig liver.
"Cough cough cough cough cough!"
Xia Yihuo stood up and patted his back, "You're not going to have such a big reaction, right? When I heard that you were going to marry Yue Ran, I didn't have such a big reaction."
Lin Shuofeng almost choked to death, but it took him a while to recover, "Of course this is different!"
He was not married yet, but his sister was already married, or she suddenly got married within a few hours of her disappearance.
No matter it is the modern world or the world of cultivation, no one in either world who is worthy of his sister has been born yet!
Lin Shuofeng obviously couldn't accept this fact.
"Sister, are you kidding me? This is not funny at all."
But seeing his sister's "What do you think?" expression, Lin Shuofeng was completely shattered.
"Who is that man? What is going on?"
Xia Yilu narrated what happened after she fell into the Yunwu Valley.
Lin Shuofeng's expression became increasingly ugly. Their marriage contract was even a life-and-death contract. What if something happened to that man and his sister was implicated?
"That's it. Do you know who that person is?"
The only thing she was worried about at the moment was whether she would release a devil who did all kinds of evil.
Lin Shuofeng's brows were already knitted into the Chinese character "Sichuan", "I've never heard of this person, I'll check it out later."
"And what on earth is that on your wrist?"
It was because of this that his sister was forced to marry a strange man.
But without the shield generated by this thing, his sister would probably be dead.
Xia Yilu shook her right wrist and said, "I don't know, the original owner doesn't have this thing in his memory."
She can't tell whether this thing is good or bad for her. At present, she prefers more good things.
I just don’t know why it insists on letting her marry Wang Shu.
She described some of Wang Shu's characteristics again and asked Lin Shuofeng to look for those demons. As long as she was sure that the other party was not a demon, she would feel relieved.
Lin Shuofeng nodded and wrote it down carefully.
That damn man must be caught.
As mentioned before about the original owner, Xia Yihuo thought of one thing, "I want to go back to Dongning Village later."
Dongdongning Village is the village where the original owner lived.
"The original owner came to Ziyun Sect to deliver the spiritual plants. After delivering the spiritual plants, it's time to go back to the village to report the situation and bring the reward back to them."
